description: Build a flashcard set and publish it to the learner's Vocabit app. Returns a deep link that opens the set on their device. Prefer one focused topic and 8-15 cards per set — long sets get abandoned. Use the notes field for what you want to check afterwards; the learner never sees it.

cards.description: The flashcards, 1-300. Keep a set to one theme and around 8-15 cards for a single session

definition.description: Translation or definition, in the learner's own language

example.description: A short sentence showing the term in use

term.description: The word or phrase in the language being learned

description.description: Short description shown under the title

notes.description: Your own notes about what to check when reviewing results. Never shown to the learner

notify.description: Ping the learner on Telegram that the set is ready

title.description: Set title as the learner will see it in the app

topic.description: Topic tag used to group sets and to filter them later, e.g. 'church vocabulary'

userId.description: Firebase UID of the learner. Omit to use the server default

name: create_study_set

deepLink.description: Universal link that opens the set in the app

title: Create a study set
